features.name: agent_auc_nonalt_interval
features.rationale: Interaction between slower tapping and nonalternating events; may expose a nonadditive motor pattern.

features.name: agent_auc_interval_tail
features.rationale: Extreme inter-tap gap relative to robust within-task spread, with guarded division.

features.name: agent_auc_f0_cv
features.rationale: Pitch dispersion relative to mean pitch; avoids assuming absolute pitch has the same meaning across participants.

features.name: agent_auc_shimmer_logcontrast
features.rationale: Compress and contrast longer/shorter amplitude-perturbation scales.

features.name: agent_auc_motor_product
features.rationale: Bound extreme motor interaction magnitudes with logarithmic transforms.

features.name: agent_auc_tap_voice
features.rationale: Cross-modal interaction between tapping variability and acoustic perturbation.
